headline: Approved 20-year renewal of Cross Street voucher contract, $100,000 Section 8 reserve use, FY2027 rent standards, and numerous contractor and vendor payments.
summary: The board approved the August 2026 bills, several contractor change orders, and vendor payments including Atlantic Awning, Homer Contracting, and South Coast Improvement Company. It also approved a 20-year renewal of the Cross Street voucher contract, authorized up to $100,000 from Section 8 reserves, adopted HUD's FY2027 fair market rents, approved staff performance bonuses, a tenant balance write-off, a donation to MassNAHRO, and spending for the annual holiday party.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the 9-2-26 meeting.
Approved bills and signing of checks for Section 8, MRVP and the Revolving Fund Register for August 2026.
Approved authorization for MHA's Board Chair or Executive Director to accept, execute and submit all future EOHLC Docusign CFA Amendments/Awards/Agreements.
Approved revised wording of agenda item 3D from the September 2, 2026 Board meeting regarding Resolution 2026-11.
Approved payment of $8,567.95 to the YMCA for the Linden and Newland Afterschool/Summer Programs.
Approved payment of $19,482.50 to Atlantic Awning for the second phase of replacing the awning at 630 Salem Street.
Approved payment of $3,569.50 to Manette Donovan, Esq. for work on the Fair Housing Four Factor Analysis and Language Access Plan.
Approved authorizing MHA to expend up to $100,000.00 from Section 8 Program Unrestricted Reserves for CY2026 and CY2027 if needed.
Approved and adopted HUD's Published FY2027 Fair Market Rents as MHA's Section 8 Program Payment Standards.
Approved renewal of the Malden Project Based Voucher Program HAP Contract with Housing Families, Inc. for Cross Street (19 units) extended to August 31, 2046.
Approved change order of $2,455.47 to Civic Plus to update the MHA website for ADA compliance.
Approved change order #2 of $5,466.00 to Homer Contracting for storm doors and entry trim on the AMP 1 Linden Window and Siding Project.
Approved payment of performance bonuses to MHA staff for the Forestdale ModPhase Project leasing.
Approved an additional tenant balance write off of $3,017.00.
Approved change order #045 of $11,107.80 to South Coast Improvement Company for City of Malden permit fees on the Suffolk Manor Amp 2 stove to electrification project.
Approved payment of eight invoices to the Malden Police Department totaling $6,747.80 for detail coverage at MHA developments.
Approved a donation of $6,250.00 to MassNAHRO for their 2026 Annual Gala.
Confirmed Maintenance Laborer Scott DeSalvo's use of vacation and/or personal time before completion of his probationary period.
Approved reimbursement check to SMRA Club President Rochelle Bluefort for purchases on her personal credit card for the July 2026 meeting.
Approved spending up to $12,500.00 for MHA's Annual Holiday Party at Anthony's of Malden on December 17, 2026.

decision_evidence.quote: VOTED: To approve the 9-2-26 meeting minutes.
VOTED: To approve the bills and signing of checks for Section 8, MRVP and the Revolving Fund Register for August, 2026.

VOTED: To approve MHA's Board Chair (Currently William P. Hurley) or Executive Director (currently Stephen G. Finn) to accept, execute and submit all future EOHLC Docusign CFA Amendments/Awards/Agreements with the Executive Director to provide a certified copy of these meeting minutes to evidence the Boards approval of each CFA Admission to EOHLC as required.
VOTED: To approve request to revise and reform wording of agenda item 3D from MHA's September 2nd, 2026 Board meeting as detailed above.
VOTED: To approve and authorize payment in the amount of $8,567.95 to the YMCA as detailed above with cost to be paid by the COCC.
VOTED: To approve payment in the amount of $19,482.50 to Atlantic Awning for second phase of replacing awning at 630 Salem Street with cost to be paid by AMP 3.
VOTED: To approve payment in the amount of $3,569.50 to Manette Donovan Esq. as detailed above with cost to be paid by the COCC.

VOTED: To approve and authorize MHA to expend up to $100,000.00 from MHA's Section 8 Program Unrestricted Reserves if needed to allow MHA to make all required HAP payments should voucher program utilization costs exceed available HUD funding in any given month during CY2026 or CY2027.

VOTED: To Approve and Adopt HUD's Published FY2027 Fair Market Rents (FMRs) as MHA's Section 8 Program Payment Standards at the percentages of 90%-100% by bedroom size as determined by the Section 8 Director for each of the FMR Areas listed on the data sheets included for this Agenda Item.

VOTED: To approve and authorize renewal of the Project Based Voucher Program HAP Contract with Housing Families, Inc for Cross Street as detailed above and authorization for Executive Director to sign same.
VOTED: To approve and authorize change order in the amount of $2,455.47 to Civic Plus as detailed above.
VOTED: To approve and authorize change order in the amount of $5,466.00 to Homer Contracting as detailed above.
VOTED: To approve payment of performance bonuses to MHA staff as detailed above with cost paid by the COCC.
VOTED: To approve an additional tenant write off in the amount of $3,017.00 as detailed above.
VOTED: To approve and authorize change order in the amount of $11,107.80 from South Coast Improvement Company as detailed above with cost paid by the CFP.

VOTED: To approve and authorize payment of eight (8) invoices to the Malden Police Department with a total cost of $6,747.80 for detail coverage at various MHA developments with cost to be allocated to the AMP's served.
VOTED: To approve and authorize a donation in the amount of $6,2500.00 to Mass NAHRO in support of their 2026 Annual Gala with cost paid by the COCC.

VOTED: To confirm Maintenance Laborer, Scott DeSalvo, to use vacation and or personal time as he may need prior to the expiration of his six-month probationary period with all such time used to be offset against such time when accrued after the satisfactory completion of his probationary period in accordance with MHA's Personnel Policy.
VOTED: To approve reimbursement check from SMRA Club President, Rochelle Bluefort, for purchases made on her personal credit card for the July 2026 meeting.

VOTED: To approve and authorize spending up to $12,500.00 from the COCC (inclusive of wait staff gratuity of 20% and entertainment costs) to fund MHA's Annual Holiday Party at Anthony's of Malden on Thursday, December 17, 2026, at Noon, together with approval for Executive Assistant, Barbara Hooley, to use her MHA Credit Card to purchase centerpieces, decorations and table food for the Event.
